questions.text: What would you like help with on this sheet?
questions.hintZh: 指出一个需要帮助的环节。

answers.text: I need help reading the new words.
acceptedForms: I need help reading the new words.

answers.text: I can read the words, but making a sentence is hard.
acceptedForms: I can read the words, but making a sentence is hard.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: What comes first in the instruction I gave?
questions.hintZh: 核查已给的两步顺序，也可坦承不确定。

answers.text: First, we circle one word.
acceptedForms: First, we circle one word.

answers.text: I am not sure which step comes first.
acceptedForms: I am not sure which step comes first.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: Would a complete example or just a starting phrase help you?
questions.hintZh: 选择支架程度。

answers.text: A complete example would help me understand the task.
acceptedForms: A complete example would help me understand the task.

answers.text: Just a starting phrase, please. I want to finish it myself.
acceptedForms: Just a starting phrase, please. I want to finish it myself.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: On this sheet, “circle” is an action. Is its meaning clear?
questions.hintZh: 指令中的用法已明确。

answers.text: Yes, it means drawing a circle around a word.
acceptedForms: Yes, it means drawing a circle around a word.

answers.text: Not yet. Could you show me on the card?
acceptedForms: Not yet. Could you show me on the card?

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: Which sentence would you like to try writing?
questions.hintZh: 两句均为可尝试的目标。

answers.text: I would like to write “I have an apple.”
acceptedForms: I would like to write “I have an apple.”

answers.text: I would like to write “This is my book.”
acceptedForms: I would like to write “This is my book.”

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: Which part of your writing would you like me to check first?
questions.hintZh: 选择反馈焦点。

answers.text: Could you check the spelling first?
acceptedForms: Could you check the spelling first?

answers.text: Please check the order of the words.
acceptedForms: Please check the order of the words.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: Look at “a book” and “two books”. What do you notice?
questions.hintZh: 例子就在题中，可观察也可求助。

answers.text: The second example has an s at the end.
acceptedForms: The second example has an s at the end.

answers.text: I see a difference, but I need help explaining it.
acceptedForms: I see a difference, but I need help explaining it.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: Could you make a new example using “apple”?
questions.hintZh: 将已给数量例子用于熟悉词。

answers.text: Yes: “one apple”.
acceptedForms: Yes: “one apple”.

answers.text: Yes: “two apples”.
acceptedForms: Yes: “two apples”.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: Would you like to check how much writing this exercise needs?
questions.hintZh: 可询问数量，也可引用已知指令。

answers.text: Yes. Do we need more than one sentence?
acceptedForms: Yes. Do we need more than one sentence?

answers.text: No, I understand that it is one sentence.
acceptedForms: No, I understand that it is one sentence.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: How would you like to begin your own attempt?
questions.hintZh: 不假设帮助请求已经得到回应。

answers.text: I will read the card and try a sentence.
acceptedForms: I will read the card and try a sentence.

answers.text: I would like to wait for a demonstration.
acceptedForms: I would like to wait for a demonstration.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: Which part of my spoken instruction would you like to hear again?
questions.hintZh: 请求重说真实给过的部分或表示无需重说。

answers.text: Please repeat the part after circling a word.
acceptedForms: Please repeat the part after circling a word.

answers.text: I do not need it repeated; I heard both steps.
acceptedForms: I do not need it repeated; I heard both steps.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

questions.text: Would it be easier to follow a written example or a slow demonstration?
questions.hintZh: 选择形式。

answers.text: A written example would be easier for me.
acceptedForms: A written example would be easier for me.

answers.text: A slow demonstration would help more.
acceptedForms: A slow demonstration would help more.

sourceBasis: CEFR2020 Companion Volume, overall oral interaction pp.70–71 and information exchange, goal-oriented cooperation and clarification scales; https://rm.coe.int/cefr-companion-volume-with-new-descriptors-2020/16809ea0d4. Design interpretation: docs/research/2026-09-09-local-learning-evidence.md. Original fictional study practice, not certification.

variants.situationZh: 虚构课堂，老师 Lee 与你看一张小练习纸，内容全部在题目中给出。桌上有铅笔、蓝笔和写着 apple / book 的图卡。Lee 已说：“Circle one word, then write a sentence.” 这是真正可请求重说的已给指令；尚未解释答案、批改或答应课后帮助。每道题引入自己的小例子，不要求外部课程知识。

short.achievedClosing: This question practice is complete. Requests for explanation remain requests; no marking or extra help has been promised.
short.partialClosing: We will stop here with some learning choices unconfirmed. You can keep your question for later practice.

standard.achievedClosing: This question practice is complete. Requests for explanation remain requests; no marking or extra help has been promised.
standard.partialClosing: We will stop here with some learning choices unconfirmed. You can keep your question for later practice.

extended.achievedClosing: This question practice is complete. Requests for explanation remain requests; no marking or extra help has been promised.
extended.partialClosing: We will stop here with some learning choices unconfirmed. You can keep your question for later practice.

variants.situationZh: 虚构课堂的图卡练习角，老师 Lee 想先确认你需要怎样的示范。桌上有铅笔、蓝笔和 apple / book 图卡。Lee 已说：“Circle one word, then write a sentence.” 可以请求说明，也可以尝试自己做；没有默认你做错了，也没有假设老师已回答你的请求。题内的小例子均为原创练习材料。

short.achievedClosing: This question practice is complete. Requests for explanation remain requests; no marking or extra help has been promised.
short.partialClosing: We will stop here with some learning choices unconfirmed. You can keep your question for later practice.

standard.achievedClosing: This question practice is complete. Requests for explanation remain requests; no marking or extra help has been promised.
standard.partialClosing: We will stop here with some learning choices unconfirmed. You can keep your question for later practice.

extended.achievedClosing: This question practice is complete. Requests for explanation remain requests; no marking or extra help has been promised.
extended.partialClosing: We will stop here with some learning choices unconfirmed. You can keep your question for later practice.

repairs.clarify: You can ask about the current example or instruction.
repairs.struggle: You can use a short question or either example answer.
repairs.offTopic: We can return to the small exercise on this sheet.
repairs.unknown: I have not matched that wording to a covered answer or confirmed understanding.
repairs.changed: Your new response replaces your earlier choice.
repairs.refusedClosing: We will stop this exercise. Asking for help is optional.

state.reply: What would you like help with on this sheet?

presentation.frameZh: 这是已编写的课堂角色与回应演练（A2）；部分问题是在排练如何回应，并非角色逐字发言。完整文字材料在情境说明中；文字提到图表、图片或口头指令，不表示本页已提供对应图像或音频。
